title: SafetensorError is not pickleable, potentially causing hangs in multi-process environments
author: Wehrdo

comments.author: github-actions[bot]

comments.author: Narsil
comments.body:
Hi @Wehrdo ,

I understand the issue and sympathize with the hard to debug issue.
However, I'm under the impression that the bug lies in the DataLoader, not in safetensors. Being picklable is not mandatory for exceptions.
This isn't anything new either: https://discuss.pytorch.org/t/dataset-with-unpicklable-objects-breaks-dataloader-where-num-workers-0/149580/4

Thanks a lot for sharing your workaround though I'm sure it'll help others.

I'm closing this, since the bug doesn't seem to be in this library, feel free to reopen.
